meta.title: Infaq and donations
meta.description: Official accounts of Al Muttaqin Cultural Center: Japan Post Bank for yen, QRIS for rupiah. Confirm your transfer, become a monthly donor, and calculate zakat.

hero.title: The mosque is built. Now let us keep it alive.
hero.description: Thanks to the waqf of hundreds of donors, the land and building are fully paid. Your infaq now covers what keeps the doors open every day: utilities, cleaning, the imam, and education for children and new Muslims.

points.1: Transparent: every month we publish income and expenses.
points.2: Simple: pay by yen transfer or QRIS, then confirm in one minute.
points.3: Safe: no card data is stored on this website.

programs.title: Where your infaq goes
programs.description: Choose a program or simply give to operations. Progress is updated by the treasurer each month.

accounts.title: Transfer to the mosque account
accounts.description: These are the only official accounts. The committee never asks for transfers to personal accounts.
accounts.qrisAlt: Official QRIS code of Al Muttaqin Cultural Center
accounts.scanHint: Scan with any Indonesian e-wallet or mobile banking app, enter the unique amount, then confirm below.
accounts.empty: No account available for this currency yet.

unique.title: Pick an amount, we add a unique code
unique.description: The last three digits are a random code that lets the treasurer match your transfer automatically. Please transfer the exact amount shown.
unique.customHint: Rounded to the nearest thousand before the code is added.
unique.empty: Choose an amount to generate your unique code.
unique.filled: This amount is already filled in the confirmation form below.

form.title: Tell us about your transfer
form.description: After transferring, fill in this short form so the treasurer can record your infaq in the monthly report. All fields except the amount and date are optional.

fields.amountHint: Use the unique amount shown above if you have one.
fields.name: Your name
fields.contactHint: WhatsApp, phone, or email, for a thank-you and the receipt.
fields.onBehalfHint: For example a parent, a late family member, or a group.

success.title: Thank you, jazakumullahu khairan
success.saved: Your confirmation has been recorded. The treasurer will match it with the bank statement within a few days.
success.fallback: The online database is not active yet. Tap the button below to send the same confirmation to the committee on WhatsApp.

errors.generic: The confirmation could not be sent. Please try again or contact us on WhatsApp.
errors.rateLimit: Too many submissions. Please wait a minute and try again.

recurring.title: Become a steady pillar of the mosque
recurring.description: A fixed amount every month, however small, lets the committee plan utilities and salaries with confidence. Register once, then set a reminder in your calendar.

benefits.1: Predictable income for monthly running costs
benefits.2: You can pause or stop at any time by messaging us
benefits.3: Optional: your name listed in the monthly report

fields.name: Full name
fields.publishName: You may list my name as a monthly donor in the report.

recurring.calendarTitle: Monthly infaq for Al Muttaqin Cultural Center
recurring.calendarDetails: Monthly infaq of {amount}. Transfer to the official account listed at {url} and send the confirmation form.

success.title: Welcome to the monthly donor family
success.saved: Your registration is recorded. The committee will contact you before the first payment day.
success.fallback: The online database is not active yet. Send your registration to the committee on WhatsApp with the button below.

zakatTeaser.title: Need to calculate your zakat?
zakatTeaser.description: Zakat maal, income zakat, and zakat al-fitr in yen or rupiah, with adjustable gold and rice prices. Nothing is stored.

gateway.title: Pay by card or e-wallet
gateway.description: Automatic payment through a licensed gateway is being prepared. Until then, please use the accounts above.
